remaining_limit: S15: queued automation re-checked inside the applying write. S16: CaseApplyRecheck binds a check for the duration of an apply; every case-file write and every map link write runs it inside its own savepoint before its body. AI configured execution re-checks each effect's input versions (still in the case, still current) and the policy version it ran under; accepting a proposal re-checks its inputs; a carried job row re-checks that its result is still the current, intact (same digest, not superseded) revision of that job and that every reference that resolved when read still resolves. A refusal (CaseApplyRecheck.Refused) leaves nothing; compensating cancellations run unchecked. Tested by binding the checks over real writes; the AI execute path itself is covered by the S10 suites (unchanged behaviour when inputs are current), not by an in-flight change during a scripted run. A multi-write effect (create action, then its contract) can be refused at its second write, leaving the first (the task is then cancelled, as before).

The acceptance is tested in-process, inside the App Sandbox: every XML parser in Ingestion refuses external entities; a source audit fails if a reader gains a network client or web renderer; archive members cannot escape the container (traversal refused, compression-ratio bound); hostile or over-long attachment names become one safe component; binary readers are fuzzed with time and size bounds (SEC-10).
